description: Collects softflowd NetFlow v5/v9/IPFIX over UDP and files first-seen external peers, high-volume flows, and long-lived flows.
name: softflowd_feed

signals.description: A flow's destination is an external address -- not private, loopback, link-local, or multicast, and not allowlisted -- never seen before.
signals.name: flow_new_external_peer

signals.description: A single flow carried at least high_volume_bytes bytes.
signals.name: flow_high_volume

signals.description: A single flow lasted at least long_lived_sec seconds from first packet to last.
signals.name: flow_long_lived
